storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Streamate Downloader makes it easy to capture live streams and download recordings from Streamate.com.

How it works: Go to any model's page on Streamate while they are live, then click the download button on the player or the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension detects the stream from multiple sources, shows available quality options, and captures it as a standard MP4 file. For live streams, click Start to begin capturing and Stop when you're done.

It handles HLS streaming, Streamate's manifest server, CDN host probing, and Mouflon encryption automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized STREAMATE subfolder.

Key features:
- Live stream capture with real-time start/stop controls
- Automatic stream detection from Streamate APIs and CDN hosts
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- VR stream support with metadata detection
- Real-time download progress with segment counter and elapsed time
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- VOD (recorded video) download support
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Streamate.com and open a model's page
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. For live streams: click Start to capture, Stop when done
5. For recordings: select quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I capture a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any live model's page on Streamate.com. Click the download button or the extension icon. Select your quality and click Start. The extension captures the stream in real time. Click Stop when you want to finish — the recording saves as MP4.

faq.question: Can I download recorded videos too?
faq.answer: Yes. Navigate to a model's video page (VOD) and use the extension just like any video downloader — select quality and download.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available stream qualities from the source — typically multiple resolutions. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a STREAMATE subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: Does this support VR streams?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects VR camera settings and includes VR metadata (stereoPacking, frameFormat, angle) in the filename.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why can't the extension find the stream?
faq.answer: Make sure the model is currently live. If they are offline or in a private show, the extension will show a status message. Refresh the page if issues persist.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Stream processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
